Engage your audience at every stage of the customer journey

### Build awareness

Help new customers get to know your business. Once they opt in to receive WhatsApp messages from you, you can start personalized marketing messages to build awareness.

Use awareness marketing messages to:

*   Share new products or services
*   Nurture leads

### Drive sales

Spark sales with messages that announce deals or share promotions and coupons.

Use these marketing messages to:

*   Make product recommendations
*   Announce a price drop
*   Make targeted offers
*   Offer assisted selling

### Retarget to re-engage

Use marketing messages to revive dormant customers who visited your website or used your app in the past.

Use re-engagement marketing messages to:

*   Revive an abandoned cart
*   Renew a lapsed subscription
*   Share loyalty offers
*   Upsell products or services

### Promote your app

### Build relationships

![Demonstration of a business building a relationship with a customer with a birthday discount code](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/ConversationCategories-Marketing-5-Build-relationships.png?w=688)

# About marketing messages

Copy link

Marketing messages is now business broadcasts in some countries. Business broadcasts might not be available to you yet. If you're seeing business broadcasts, please refer to [this article](https://faq.whatsapp.com/1524953031793983/?helpref=faq_content).

As your small business grows, you need more powerful tools and messaging capabilities to scale your operation. With marketing messages on the WhatsApp Business app, you can send customized messages to multiple people at once to re-engage your audience efficiently. Marketing messages can help you improve message response rates and build stronger relationships with your customers while saving time.

With marketing messages, you pay for each message that is delivered to a receiver you chose within five days of being sent.

You can also see how many of your customers have read and replied to your messages to understand how they perform. You can use this information to help improve your future marketing messages.

**Note**: This information won’t reflect receivers who have turned off read receipts, or any messages delivered while your own device’s read receipts is turned off. Marketing messages is currently available in limited countries and might not be available to you yet.

Click [here](https://wa.me/marketingmessages) to get started with business broadcasts.

# Business Platform Pricing

## Simple and transparent pricing

Drive your business goals for growth and customer engagement knowing pricing on WhatsApp is consistent with industry-standard pricing for messaging.

[Learn more](https://whatsappbusiness.com/learn-more)

[Find a partner](https://business.facebook.com/messaging/partner-showcase/?ref=WAB_PLATFORM_PRICING#)

![Person in a store holding an iPad](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Person-at-shop-with-iPad.jpg?w=1000)

## The simplicity you need to connect at scale, create better customer experiences and better engage with your audience.

![Person holding a mug looking at a laptop](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/User-Initiated-2.jpg?w=1000)

## Businesses using our platform are charged on a per-message basis for each message we deliver to users

*   We charge when a message is **delivered** (not sent).
*   We charge based on **who the message is sent to** and the **category of the message**.
    *   There are four message categories on the WhatsApp Business Platform: marketing, utility, authentication, and service.
*   Our rates **vary by market – category pair**, and we [**publish our rates for transparency**](https://whatsappbusiness.com/products/platform-pricing/#rates).

## We provide several ways for businesses to get value

![Green icon of person outline with a heart](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Take-care-of-your-customers.svg)

### Be there for your customers

_with service and utility messages_

Helping your customers is always a priority. That’s why we **do not charge** for service messages, or for utility messages businesses send in response to users.

![Green icon of a rocket ship](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/rocket-e1776029091253.png?w=57)

### Get rewarded as you grow

_with utility and authentication messages_

As businesses send more messages on WhatsApp, they can **unlock more attractive pricing** via our volume tiers.

![Green icon of an ad or webpage](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/web-page-icon.svg)

### Leverage free entry points

_across all message categories_

When customers send you a message from an **[Ad that clicks to WhatsApp](https://whatsappbusiness.com/products/ads-that-click-to-whatsapp)** or **[Facebook Page call-to-action button](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/766428573472938)**, for the following 3 days (72 hours), all of your messages are not charged.

## Per-message pricing empowers you to create better customer experiences and better engage with your audience.

![The four conversation categories: Marketing, Utility, Authentication, and Service](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Conversation-based-pricing-accordion.webp)

![Hiking Shoes | Hi Kazuo! Get ready for a hiking trip with our new hiking shoes! Find adventure wherever you go with #myNTO!](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Marketing.jpg)

![Hi Ana, your flight is in 6 hours. Here's your boarding pass.](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Utility.jpg?w=1024)

![Text notification that says: 288955 is your verification code. For your security, do not share this code.](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Authentication.jpg?w=1024)

![Text conversation that reads: Hi there, can you remind me when my appointment is later today? | Hi Anika, thanks for reaching out! Your appointment is at 2pm this afternoon](https://whatsappbusiness.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Service.jpg?w=1024)

## Explore each message category to understand how they can be used across your customers’ journey.

Marketing

Marketing messages can help businesses achieve a wide range of goals across the funnel, from generating awareness to driving sales to retargeting customers. These messages can include offers and promos, related product suggestions, abandoned cart reminders, and more.

[Learn more](https://whatsappbusiness.com/products/conversation-categories/marketing)

Utility

Utility messages are typically triggered by a user action, like placing an order or submitting a payment. These messages are not promotional, and are either specific to or requested by a user (like a package delivery update) or critical to a user (like a tornado warning).

[Learn more](https://whatsappbusiness.com/products/conversation-categories/utility)

Authentication

Authentication messages enable businesses to use one-time passwords (OTPs) for identity verification, potentially at multiple stages of the user journey. Ensure successful login or transactions with OTPs on WhatsApp.

[Learn more](https://whatsappbusiness.com/products/conversation-categories/authentication)

Service

These messages enable businesses to manage incoming customer inquiries, whether that is via an agent or a conversational AI-powered bot. When users message a business, this opens a 24-hour customer service window during which businesses can respond with service messages. This window resets with each user message.

[Learn more](https://whatsappbusiness.com/products/conversation-categories/service)

WhatsApp is among the [top digital marketing tools](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/digital-marketing/best-software/) because it’s accessible, practical and comprehensive. The app had more than 3 billion active users in 2026 and is the most widely used instant messaging app worldwide.

WhatsApp covers about 180 countries. Thousands of companies have use it as a marketing, sales, and customer service channel. However, many brands still view WhatsApp as a separate platform that doesn't require the same planning as other communication channels. While it generates results, this view reduces the [omnichannel](https://www.salesforce.com/commerce/what-is-omnichannel/) model and can put your business at a disadvantage compared with the competition.

In this article we'll explain what WhatsApp marketing is and why using the app alone isn't enough to implement this strategy. You'll understand:

*   What exactly is WhatsApp marketing
*   Why is it important to apply this strategy
*   What are the benefits of WhatsApp for your digital marketing
*   How to connect the app to the channels you already use (and how Salesforce can help with this process)

## What is WhatsApp Business?

Created in 2009, WhatsApp became popular by as a free version of SMS messaging. With internet access and a linked mobile phone number, it was possible to synchronize contacts on the device and exchange text messages, audio messages, images and videos, as well as make phone calls and video calls.

In 2014, the app was acquired by Facebook (now Meta) for $22 billion. Initially, this move brought WhatsApp closer to social networks by introducing new features, such as status sharing (a feature of Snapchat and Instagram Stories) and image editing capabilities.

Later, as with Meta's previous acquisitions, certain new developments expanded its corporate use, culminating in the launch of WhatsApp Business in 2018. At that time, WhatsApp was already being used for scheduling services, executive meetings and even video conferencing.

However, the app already announced possibilities such as:

*   Real-time customer service
*   Promotion of products and services
*   Customer loyalty initiatives (such as sending discount coupons and exclusive promotions)
*   Direct contact with suppliers
*   Closing sales and other commercial transactions

### WhatsApp Business features

WhatsApp Business launched with a similar interface to the regular version and features that improved business interaction management. These are some of the app's main features:

#### Business Profile

When registering an account, the company can add a brief description and details such as segment, address, opening hours, website and primary email.

#### Automatic Messages

You can set up automatic messages to greet customers in chat, confirm receipt of messages, and communicate when agents are unavailable.

#### Catalog

The company can create a portfolio within the app , including descriptions, photos, typical prices, and even featured offers for products and services.

#### Conversation markers

Conversations can be tagged according to company criteria, classifying contacts as "customers," " prospects ," "suppliers," and more. Tags can also indicate the stage each negotiation is in ("proposal sent," "order received," etc.).

#### Broadcast lists

They allow you to send the same message to up to 256 contacts at once. They were created as an alternative to groups, to facilitate secure content distribution (only the company can send messages to its broadcast lists).

#### Metrics

The company can create a portfolio within the app , including descriptions, photos, typical prices, and even featured offers for products and services.

According to Meta data, more than a billion users connect corporate accounts to the company's messengers every week – which reiterates WhatsApp's dominance as a channel for direct interaction and engagement, followed by Facebook Messenger and Instagram Direct.
